ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Masterio Pro uses your location to offer you nearby orders and to show the client where you are during an active order.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Allow "Always" so orders and live tracking keep working when Masterio Pro is in the background. Location is shared with the client only during an active order.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Allow "Always" so orders and live tracking keep working when Masterio Pro is in the background. Location is shared with the client only during an active order.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Masterio Pro uses the camera to photograph your documents, selfie and work results.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Masterio Pro needs access to photos to upload your documents.
